messages.subject: Indigo - IP due diligence & FTO report
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our IP due-diligence and freedom-to-operate report attached. Headlines: portfolio is clean and well-maintained; CL-PAT-004 needs a confirmatory assignment from Theo Eriksson and recordal; a third-party observation against CL-PAT-008(EP) shouldn't prevent grant; and on FTO the only item of note is US 11,204,883 (Meridian Atmospherics) on the SAF module - in our view non-infringing with a design-around available. Residual risk low.

Alan Foster
Hartington IP
